name: Hijiri Ayaka
source:
Born on May 12, 1989.
A girl who is active in the entertainment industry as an idol. She is said to be the #1 most popular idol, but other than the fact that she is often late or absent to class due to work, she is still a normal student with an honest and friendly personality, while hiding the fact that she is an idol. Although she is very popular with the boys, she receives animosity from some of the girls.
She belongs to the Guitar club, but due to her job, she barely participates in club activities. Her producer is her mother, Hijiri Saori, who is a former idol herself.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
